scope: Four isolated reusable lesson object tiles. No scenery panels.

calls.prompt: Use case: isolated reusable game decoration tile for the Horizons companion learning map. Image 1 R01 is the mandatory brand palette and flat rendering reference, not an edit target. Image 2 R02 is the mandatory cast shape-language reference only: do NOT depict a character. Image 3 R07 is the mandatory native prop and landmark style reference, not a scenery layout to copy. Produce ONE isolated complete small inanimate object tile for 1A New friends. Two small cafe mugs side by side, one warm coral and one mustard yellow, simple complete handles, tiny dark coffee ovals. A friendly meeting over coffee. No steam wisps or saucers.. Centered complete silhouette with at least 18 percent empty margin on every side, clear at 50-65 CSS pixels, front/slightly elevated three-quarter view matching the simple native Horizons props. Restrained large geometric shapes; flat solid opaque colors; clean native raster edges. TRUE transparent background outside the object only. NO characters, faces, eyes, animals, landscape, ground, floor, terrain slab, connected scenery, path, trees, decorative confetti, text, letters, border, outline, cast shadow, glow, gradient, modeled lighting, texture or tiny fussy details. This is a standalone reusable tile, not a scene or chunk of environment. Keep the transparent background and every solid interior genuinely opaque.
calls.verdict: Rejected: cup glow/filled handles or globe edge speckles. See isolated opaque-background repair.

calls.prompt: Repair this isolated Horizons object tile. Inputs 1 R01, 2 R02 and 3 R07 are mandatory brand/native-shape references, not targets. Input 4 is the exact generated object to repair. Preserve the recognizable subject, large simple shape, colors and complete silhouette. Remove ALL glow, halo, shadow, translucent haze, gradient, scattered crumbs and edge speckles. Use only flat solid opaque fills with clean crisp native raster edges. IMPORTANT: render on a completely UNIFORM OPAQUE saturated magenta #ff00ff background, including intentional empty holes and openings. No transparency in this output. No magenta pixels inside solid object regions. No floor, ground, scene, text, labels or extra objects. Keep generous 18 percent background margin around the entire isolated object. The two mugs must each have a complete OPEN curved handle; the handle holes show the exact uniform magenta background. Keep coral and yellow mug bodies with dark navy coffee ovals. No steam.
calls.verdict: Selected opaque magenta-background repair for documented mechanical extraction.
